$comment: Reviewed uses of a banned word that are true, for scripts/site/banned-words.mjs. A hit is allowed when its word matches `term` and the copy string (or the 120 characters around it on a built page) contains `context`. `where` is copy, html or both (the default). Every entry needs a reason; an entry that matches nothing fails the check. Reviewed 24 Oct 2026 by the Go-live lane against honesty.md; the site lane may reword any of these lines instead, and then the entry is removed.
